annotations.title: Start a 3D picture of the plan (solar roof check)

description: An image (PNG, or JPEG when large) of the plan behind a solar roof check link, drawn by the solar roof check page itself in 3D, from a fixed, named view: front (the start view the page opens with, three-quarters from above), above (straight down, north up), north, east, south or west (from that side, 35° up, about square on to a roof face), or sun (the roof's sun map, "Sonnendach", from above). The same plan and view give the same picture (within a calendar year, while the map data stays the same): the camera follows the house, the sun stands at 21 June, 13:00, nothing moves, no cat and no editing marks, the plan's fine print as on the page. So variants of a plan compare side by side, which screenshots of the page do not (its view moves). Size up to 1600 × 1000 pixels (default). Answers at once with a job_id: the server draws the 3D in software, which takes 30 to 150 seconds. Then call roof_picture_status every 10 seconds until done, and roof_picture_file to get the picture (a JPEG instead of a PNG when the PNG would be over about 1.4 MB). The picture is kept for 15 minutes under the random job_id; nothing else is stored.

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.

view.description: Which view: front (the start view the solar roof check page opens with: three-quarters from above, square on to the main south-facing roof); above (straight down from above, north up); north (from the north, 35° up (about square on to a roof face, and over the neighbours)); east (from the east, 35° up); south (from the south, 35° up); west (from the west, 35° up); sun (the roof's sun ("Sonnendach") on the plain white model, straight down from above, north up: the warmer a spot, the more sun over the year). Default front.
